item.title: Calibrating an LLM judge against human labels
item.description: An LLM judge is a model that reads the output of another model and decides whether the output is good. Teams use LLM judges because people are too slow to grade every output, and exact string matching can’t grade open-ended answers. The problem is that a judge is also a model, and a judge makes mistakes. If you report “92% of answers passed” and the judge is wrong on one answer in five, nobody knows what the 92% means.

item.title: Implementing HashTable in Java
item.description: I have been asked before how I would implement a hash table in Java. Before going into the code, here are the steps I used to implement HashTable. Encapsulate the key, the value, and a link to the next entry in a HashEntry class. Create the buckets, which are an array of HashEntry. put(key, value) calculates the bucket index from the hash code of key. If the bucket is empty, the new entry becomes the first entry of the bucket.
